all_original_proposals.prior_family_row: | PH2 F Q/P | HostBoundCavity as Subject specialization of Feature, and CavityHostedBy as structural directed relation cavity → material host. Host supplies identity/boundaries, occupant is separate. | Positive: drilled bore remains the same cavity when filled with water under stated continuity criteria. Earlier `physical-HostBoundVoid` and `physical-VoidHostedBy` are corresponding candidates; narrowed name avoids implying vacuum. |
